preconditions.description: The number of employees is at least 1 and at most 5 * 10^5.
The number of teams is at least 1 and at most 8000.
Each employee's team number is between 1 and k, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Every team contains at least one employee.
preconditions.description: There is at least one employee in each team.

postconditions.description: The minimum cost of the rent is at least the number of employees.
The output is the total cost of the rent, where s is the bus capacity and r is the number of rides.

postconditions.expression: all(t_i in t for t in teams) for i in range(n)
postconditions.description: All employees are assigned to their respective teams.

postconditions.expression: no team is split across rides
postconditions.description: No team is split across multiple rides; all employees of a team take the same ride.

postconditions.expression: no more than two teams take a ride together
postconditions.description: No more than two teams take a ride together; three or more teams starting a new project is unacceptable.

postconditions.expression: output == min(s * r for s in range(1, n + 1) for r in range(1, (n // s) + 1) if s * r >= n)
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum cost among all possible bus capacities and rides that can accommodate all employees.
